brief:
Settlers attacked a foreign solidarity activist and Palestinian civilians in Yatta, Shehab Wire reported. The assault resulted in injuries to multiple people. The incident occurred in the southern West Bank area, where settler violence against Palestinians and international supporters has been a recurrent problem.

The attack took place in Yatta, located in the Hebron governorate, a region that has experienced repeated clashes between settlers and Palestinian residents. International activists have increasingly traveled to occupied territories to document alleged abuses and support Palestinian communities facing settlement expansion and related hostilities.
